Nadia R.: Hi team — I submitted my resignation to my manager today. Last day will be 2024-09-15 (Im UK-based). A few items: Im on the US medical plan (company-paid) but living in the UK  how does COBRA work for me? Also need guidance on UK pension transfer, final pay (holiday accrual), and laptop return logistics (can't ship to the US). I'm on the on-call rota through 9/14  need a safe handoff so PagerDuty isn't left uncovered. RSUs show a vest on 2024-09-20  will that be affected? Can Slack be set to read-only for two weeks for KT? Thanks.
Liam (People Ops): Sorry to hear that, Nadia. Quick answers: 1) COBRA is handled by BenefitAdmin; they mail a hard copy and email a notice. Election window is 60 days from the date the notice is mailed. 2) UK pension transfers are managed with our benefits partner  we'll DM you a checklist. 3) Final pay usually includes pro-rated salary + payment for unused statutory holiday (per local law) and processes on the next payroll after termination. 4) IT can arrange local courier returns or office drop-off in London  @Gareth will advise. 5) We can set Slack to read-only for 2 weeks. We'll open an offboard ticket and enumerate actions.
Nadia R.: Thanks. About COBRA  BenefitAdmin might mail to my US home address on file (I moved). Can they send only to my company email? I need clarity on the election start date so my partner can line up interim coverage.
Marta (HR): We can request BenefitAdmin to email the COBRA notice to your company email and update the mailing address to your UK address. Policy note: plan docs require a mailed copy to the address of record, but they almost always also send an email copy. We'll add: subject line to expect is "COBRA election notice  Redwood".
Helena (Payroll): Payroll note: final paycheck runs on the next scheduled payroll (biweekly). It will include prorated salary + payout for untaken statutory holiday (UK rules) and any approved expense reimbursements in queue. If you are on local payroll paid in GBP, we will calculate per your local contract. DM me payroll country and employee ID and I'll verify estimates.
Gareth - IT: Nadia  for devices in the UK we can either ship a prepaid UPS/DPD label to your home (if local) or you can drop at our London partner depot. Please do not factory reset the machine; remove personal files if you want. We'll image on receipt. We normally schedule SSO disable at 18:00 UTC on the last day and revoke GitHub/CI tokens the following morning at 07:00 UTC. Do you need different timing because of on-call?
Nadia R.: Id prefer SSO disabled EOD (18:00 UTC) and GitHub revoked next morning (07:00 UTC) so I can finish PR handovers. On-call handover is booked 2024-09-14 08:00 BST with @Tom. Ill populate the runbooks under /docs/oncall and update PagerDuty ownership before the KT.
Tom (Eng): Ill pair during the 9/14 session and take ownership of the two services. Please @mention me on the runbook pages and push outstanding PRs to reviewers. I'll reassign ownership as needed.
comp-admin: Adding a note  per initial review of your grant, vesting is tied to active employment. If your termination date is before 2024-09-20, typically the scheduled vest would not occur. I'll confirm and follow up with a formal comp email within 2 business days.
security-bot: Offboard ticket #OB-2024-529 created. Scheduled actions: SSO disable 2024-09-15T18:00:00Z, VPN cert revoke 2024-09-15T18:30:00Z, GitHub token revoke 2024-09-16T07:00:00Z, Google Workspace license suspend 2024-09-29T00:00:00Z.
Nadia R.: Thanks all  appreciate the clarity. One last ask: can we keep calendar access visible to the team for two weeks and forward new incoming mail to my manager for 30 days?
Liam (People Ops): Yes  we'll set calendar visibility for two weeks and forward inbound mail to your manager for 30 days. Sending you the exit questionnaire link and a scheduler for a 30-min exit interview. Please book a morning slot next week if possible.
Nadia R.: Booked the exit interview for 2024-09-18 09:30 BST. Will watch for BenefitAdmin and the comp-admin confirmation. Thanks everyone. :heart:
